articles.title: Delhi Wakes to Post-Diwali Smog as AQI Hits 368, 15 Areas Turn Severe

articles.title: Delhi AQI Hits 451 as Purifier Costs Put Clean Indoor Air Out of Reach
articles.excerpt: As the capital's air enters the severe zone ahead of Diwali, residents say the machines, filters and systems sold as protection are priced beyond most households — and doctors warn even a purifier is no guarantee.

articles.nri_angle: Diaspora families visiting Delhi for Diwali face the same severe air; the article gives them the mask, room and AQI steps doctors actually recommend.
